scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,inspector -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @ay-ple/server" "npm run dev -w @ay-ple/inspector"
scripts.dev:chat-shell: concurrently -n server,chat-shell -c blue,magenta "CODEX_CHAT_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:4173 npm run dev -w @ay-ple/server" "npm run dev -w @ay-ple/chat-shell"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ay-ple/runtime-core && npm run test -w @ay-ple/runtime-codex && npm run test -w @ay-ple/codex-chat-runtime && npm run test -w @ay-ple/server && npm run test -w @ay-ple/chat-shell && npm run test -w @ay-ple/inspector
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @ay-ple/inspector && npm run test:e2e -w @ay-ple/chat-shell
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ay-ple/runtime-core && npm run build -w @ay-ple/runtime-fake && npm run build -w @ay-ple/runtime-codex && npm run build -w @ay-ple/codex-chat-runtime && npm run build -w @ay-ple/server && npm run build -w @ay-ple/chat-shell && npm run build -w @ay-ple/inspector
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/runtime-core && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/runtime-fake && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/runtime-codex && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/codex-chat-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/server && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/chat-shell && npm run typecheck -w @ay-ple/inspector
